set_window.name: Set window
set_window.description: Opens or closes window and door contacts; without `open` they toggle.

open.name: Open
open.description: Open (on) or closed (off); leave out to toggle.

turn_dial.name: Turn dial
turn_dial.description: Changes a thermostat at the device itself: half-degree steps without a Home Assistant context.

hvac_mode.name: Mode
hvac_mode.description: Switch off or on at the device.

set_air_temperature.name: Set air temperature
set_air_temperature.description: Jumps a room's simulated air temperature.

drop_connection.name: Drop connection
drop_connection.description: Makes thermostats unavailable for a while, like a Matter connection hiccup.
